scope: Permanent redundant health monitoring for subscribed Fortnite, Harry Potter and Pokemon calendars in QuentinGranger/demo

principles.subscription_path_stability: A subscribed .ics path on the pinned master branch is a public compatibility contract. Never rename/remove it silently. If an internal migration is needed, keep the old path as a valid compatibility mirror unless the user explicitly accepts a subscription URL change.
principles.no_expiry: Recurring health-critical monitor schedules must not contain RRULE UNTIL or COUNT unless explicitly requested by the user.
principles.no_news_is_not_failure: A calendar may legitimately receive no Git commit for a long period. Health is based on monitor liveness, repository/path/raw-endpoint availability and ICS integrity, not file modification frequency alone.
principles.no_single_watchdog: No single ChatGPT automation is authoritative for cross-calendar health. At least two independent recurring observers must be able to inspect all monitored automations; GitHub Actions is the external validation plane.
principles.incident_only_state_writes: Routine healthy checks do not update calendar-health-state.json. Persist only incident transitions or deliberate policy migrations.
principles.low_frequency_heartbeat: calendar-health-heartbeat.json is a low-frequency observer proof and snapshot, not a calendar fact. Any declared observer may refresh it after a successful cross-check.
principles.respect_manual_control: Never silently re-enable an automation the user deliberately disabled. Detect and report disabled/finite/stale monitoring instead.
principles.same_path_repair: If a subscribed ICS is damaged or deleted and can be deterministically repaired from canonical ledgers without inventing facts, restore the same master-branch path rather than creating a replacement URL.
principles.external_failure_record: GitHub Actions must maintain one persistent GitHub issue for health-validator failure and close it on recovery, avoiding one issue per failed run.

automation_liveness.first_run_rule: If last_run_time is null, do not fail before the first recurrence that should occur after the automation's latest update/create time plus the cadence grace window.
automation_liveness.finite_rule: A recurring health-critical monitor is finite if its RRULE contains UNTIL or COUNT.
automation_liveness.cadence_rule: A monitored automation must preserve its declared FREQ; changing HOURLY to DAILY/WEEKLY or DAILY to another cadence is a health incident even when recurrence is infinite.
automation_liveness.enabled_rule: is_enabled must remain true unless the user intentionally changes it.
automation_liveness.timezone_rule: default_timezone must remain Europe/Paris for these France/Europe monitoring automations unless migration is explicit.

observers.rule: Every declared ChatGPT observer performs the lightweight cross-check on each run. If one observer dies, the other can open the incident. GitHub Actions remains independent of ChatGPT and detects stale heartbeat/file corruption.
observers.self_check: The currently executing observer is itself evidence of execution, but it must still inspect the other observer and all monitored schedules via automations state.

heartbeat.write_rule: Any declared observer may refresh after a successful cross-calendar check when the previous heartbeat is at least 24 hours old, or immediately for a health-policy migration. Always use a fresh blob SHA and compare-and-swap.
heartbeat.snapshot_rule: Store each monitored automation's enabled state, expected/observed recurrence, finite flag, timezone, last_run_time and updated_at so GitHub Actions can validate per-monitor liveness from the last independent snapshot.
heartbeat.external_check: Scheduled GitHub Actions fails if the heartbeat is older than max_age_hours or if a snapshotted monitor is already beyond its own liveness threshold.

required: no duplicate VEVENT UID within one file
online_required_for_globals: raw URL returns HTTP success after bounded retries
raw body X-WR-CALNAME matches the repository copy
raw content hash matches the checked-out repository file
ics_checks.franchise_specific_validation: Run the franchise's stricter validator whenever one exists. Generic health validation does not replace domain-specific validation.
ics_checks.raw_subscription_contract: raw.githubusercontent.com/QuentinGranger/demo/master/<path> must continue to map to the same subscribed path. Do not silently migrate to a different branch or filename.

repair_order: fresh-read canonical ledgers and surviving specialist/global views
reconstruct deterministic ICS business state at the same path when possible
manual_only: automation deliberately disabled by the user

run_protocol: Read health policy/state/heartbeat and verify repository/master availability.
Verify all nine declared ICS paths and the three global subscription contracts.
Inspect all four monitored automations for existence, enabled state, infinite recurrence, expected cadence/timezone and liveness.
Verify at least minimum_enabled_observers are healthy; losing redundancy is itself an incident even if one observer remains alive.
Do not classify an unchanged ICS as stale solely from file age.
For each new incident, fresh-fetch state, append OPEN through compare-and-swap and notify once; same OPEN incident stays silent; recovery appends RECOVERED once.
Any observer may refresh heartbeat at most daily after successful cross-check; never refresh a healthy heartbeat when checks failed.
Once daily and after material ICS writes, perform deep structure/franchise validation and verify global raw subscription endpoints.
Never create a separate recurring ChatGPT automation solely for health while declared observers can perform it.
